title: BTC thirty-day return from trailing annual momentum
claim: BTC trailing 365-day return and 60-day volatility improve the next 30-day return forecast over historical-mean and zero-return controls.
mechanism: Intermediate-horizon underreaction and trend-following flows produce own-return continuation.
primaryBaseline: Stronger of expanding historical mean and zero return

evidence.summary: Development RMSE was materially worse than both controls. The attractive 90-origin holdout was statistically inconclusive and cannot rescue the failed development screen.

nextAction: Do not retune on the opened sample; only a new mechanism version and fresh preregistered confirmation period may reopen the question.
